content.short: Portfolio tracking and automatic NAV reporting for crypto funds and asset managers.
content.description: Octav watches every wallet and protocol a fund uses across more than 50 chains and 10,000 protocols, then produces daily NAV reports, PnL, exposure breakdowns and exportable snapshots for compliance. Transactions can be reviewed with AI, and dashboards are modular. It is used by more than 200 digital asset managers, covers Hyperliquid, Solana and Derive, and has a free tier and API.
content.meta: Octav automates NAV reports, PnL and exposure tracking across 50+ chains for crypto funds, with a free tier and API.
